description: Use this when a user wants a structured read on their training, nutrition, and recovery, or asks where they should focus first. Returns three pillar scores (Bulletproof Body, Fuel with Freedom, Recharge and Restore), the single biggest lever, and up to three prioritised actions. Do NOT use for medical diagnosis, injury treatment, or nutrition therapy. Do not use when the user is asking only about general fitness information, exercise form, or a single exercise's technique — answer those directly instead. This is coaching assessment, not clinical assessment.

goal.description: The primary outcome the user wants to prioritise right now.

mealTimingConsistency.description: 0-10. How consistent is your eating schedule?

movementControl.description: 0-10. How much of a full, controlled range of motion can you own?

nutritionConsistency.description: 0-10. How reliably do you hit your nutrition targets?

painFree.description: 0-10. How often are you free of aches or pains that limit your training?

proteinAdequacy.description: 0-10. Do you get enough protein without excessive effort?

recoveryPractices.description: 0-10. How consistent are your deliberate recovery practices?

sessionsPerWeek.description: How many training sessions per week do you currently complete?

sleepHours.description: Typical hours of sleep per night (4-10).

stressLevel.description: 1-10. Current chronic stress level, where 10 is maximum.

trainingYears.description: How many years have you trained seriously and consistently?

name: fitness.assess_performance_profile
title: Assess Performance Profile
